title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing a Certificate After a First-Instance Divorce Judgment Becomes Effective
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing a Certificate of Finality after a First-Instance Divorce Judgment Becomes Effective

Fa (Min) Fa [1991] No. 33

People's Courts at all levels nationwide:

Our embassies and consulates abroad and relevant domestic departments recently reported to this Court that, in their work, they are unable to determine whether a first-instance divorce judgment issued by a People's Court and held by a party has already become legally effective, which has caused inconvenience. Therefore, they suggested that this Court take measures to properly resolve this issue. Upon review, the notice is as follows:

According to Article 141 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, for a divorce judgment in a first-instance divorce case in which the parties did not appeal, after the appeal period expires and the judgment becomes legally effective, the original trial People's Court shall issue to the parties a certificate of finality of the judgment and affix the court seal, thereby confirming that the judgment has become legally effective.
